chunk_022.0x2a34:
Welcome to JUNKER HQ.
May I help you?
chunk_022.0x2a6a:
Only JUNKER personnel may
proceed beyond this point.
chunk_022.0x2a9d: Unauthorized persons are not permitted past here.
chunk_022.0x2ad6:
I can't admit anyone whose
identity is unknown.
chunk_022.0x2b05: Excuse me, but who are you?
chunk_022.0x2b8d:
This looks promising.
JUNKER has beauties like this too?
chunk_022.0x2bce: A far cry from the army staff...
chunk_022.0x2c17: Not exactly in the best taste.
chunk_022.0x2c3d: It seems to lead into HQ.
chunk_022.0x2c64: This door is the only way in.
chunk_022.0x2cf0:
It's locked.
Looks like it only opens
from inside the pod.
chunk_022.0x2d33:
This lady will have to open it
from the inside after all.
chunk_022.0x2d79:
No choice...
I'll try talking to this lady.
chunk_022.0x2de9: Looks like an HQ security camera.
chunk_022.0x2e06: Shall I give it a wave?
chunk_022.0x2e2e:
A pod-style reception.
The front itself is covered
by a shield capsule.
chunk_022.0x2ea1:
The JUNKER HQ front, it seems.
...Security is tight.
chunk_022.0x2f37:
A heat- and shock-proof shield.
Anti-Snatcher, no doubt.
chunk_022.0x2f70: Even a tank couldn't break this.
chunk_022.0x2fb6:
A shame.
And such a glamorous one too...
chunk_022.0x3008:
Are you here about the
JUNKER recruitment?
chunk_022.0x30a7:
The chief is watching that
camera feed too, you know.
chunk_022.0x32af: Lucky me, a beauty like you here.
